2. The chart must be a single self-contained PNG image file.

3. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# ── Color palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
REGION_COLORS = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": "#C0392B",
    "South Asia":         "#E67E22",
    "Europe":             "#2980B9",
    "North America":      "#27AE60",
}
REGIONS = list(REGION_COLORS.keys())
REGION_SHORT = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": "Sub-Saharan\nAfrica",
    "South Asia":         "South\nAsia",
    "Europe":             "Europe",
    "North America":      "North\nAmerica",
}

BG      = "#F8F7F4"
GRID_C  = "#DDDDDD"
ANNOT_C = "#444444"
TITLE_C = "#1A1A1A"

# ── Data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
income_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [6,  14, 25, 42, 68],
    "South Asia":         [12, 24, 39, 56, 78],
    "Europe":             [72, 82, 89, 94, 97],
    "North America":      [75, 85, 92, 96, 99],
}
quintile_labels = ["Q1\n(Lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5\n(Highest)"]

age_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [38, 32, 26, 18, 11,  5],
    "South Asia":         [55, 48, 38, 27, 16,  8],
    "Europe":             [98, 96, 93, 88, 79, 58],
    "North America":      [99, 97, 95, 91, 84, 65],
}
age_labels = ["15–24", "25–34", "35–44", "45–54", "55–64", "65+"]

urban_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": (42, 13),
    "South Asia":         (58, 22),
    "Europe":             (92, 78),
    "North America":      (95, 80),
}

overall_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": 27,
    "South Asia":         40,
    "Europe":             89,
    "North America":      93,
}

# ── Canvas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 18), facecolor=BG)
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(
    3, 2,
    figure=fig,
    hspace=0.55, wspace=0.38,
    left=0.07, right=0.97,
    top=0.88, bottom=0.07,
)

def style_ax(ax):
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines[["left","bottom"]].set_color(GRID_C)
    ax.tick_params(colors=ANNOT_C, labelsize=9)
    ax.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_C, linewidth=0.7, zorder=0)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# ── Top banner: overall penetration bar chart ──────────────────────────────
ax0 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
style_ax(ax0)

vals  = [overall_data[r] for r in REGIONS]
colors= [REGION_COLORS[r] for r in REGIONS]
x_pos = np.arange(len(REGIONS))
bars  = ax0.bar(x_pos, vals, color=colors, width=0.55, zorder=3, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5)

for bar, v in zip(bars, vals):
    ax0.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, v + 1.5, f"{v}%",
             ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", color=ANNOT_C)

ax0.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax0.set_xticklabels([REGION_SHORT[r] for r in REGIONS], fontsize=11, color=ANNOT_C)
ax0.set_ylim(0, 112)
ax0.set_ylabel("Internet Penetration (%)", fontsize=10, color=ANNOT_C)
ax0.set_title("Overall Internet Penetration by Region (2023)", fontsize=13,
              fontweight="bold", color=TITLE_C, pad=8)

# Annotate divide arrows
ax0.annotate("", xy=(2, 89), xytext=(1, 40),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color="#888", lw=1.4))
ax0.text(1.5, 67, "49 pp\ngap", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9,
         color="#666", style="italic")

# ── Panel 1: Income quintile lines ────────────────────────────────────────
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
style_ax(ax1)
x = np.arange(5)
for r in REGIONS:
    y = income_data[r]
    ax1.plot(x, y, marker="o", markersize=5, linewidth=2.2,
             color=REGION_COLORS[r], label=r, zorder=3)
    # Annotate Q1 and Q5
    ax1.text(-0.15, y[0],  f"{y[0]}%",  ha="right", va="center", fontsize=8,
             color=REGION_COLORS[r], fontweight="bold")
    ax1.text( 4.15, y[-1], f"{y[-1]}%", ha="left",  va="center", fontsize=8,
             color=REGION_COLORS[r], fontweight="bold")

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(quintile_labels, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 108)
ax1.set_ylabel("Internet Penetration (%)", fontsize=9, color=ANNOT_C)
ax1.set_xlabel("Income Quintile", fontsize=9, color=ANNOT_C)
ax1.set_title("By Income Quintile", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", color=TITLE_C)

# Highlight Q1→Q5 spread for SSA
ax1.annotate("", xy=(4, 68), xytext=(0, 6),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color=REGION_COLORS["Sub-Saharan Africa"],
                             lw=1.2, linestyle="dashed"))
ax1.text(2, 30, "+62 pp\n(SSA)", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
         color=REGION_COLORS["Sub-Saharan Africa"], style="italic")

# ── Panel 2: Age group lines ───────────────────────────────────────────────
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
style_ax(ax2)
x = np.arange(6)
for r in REGIONS:
    y = age_data[r]
    ax2.plot(x, y, marker="s", markersize=5, linewidth=2.2,
             color=REGION_COLORS[r], label=r, zorder=3)
    ax2.text(-0.15, y[0],  f"{y[0]}%", ha="right", va="center", fontsize=8,
             color=REGION_COLORS[r], fontweight="bold")
    ax2.text( 5.15, y[-1], f"{y[-1]}%", ha="left",  va="center", fontsize=8,
             color=REGION_COLORS[r], fontweight="bold")

ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_labels, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 108)
ax2.set_ylabel("Internet Penetration (%)", fontsize=9, color=ANNOT_C)
ax2.set_xlabel("Age Group", fontsize=9, color=ANNOT_C)
ax2.set_title("By Age Group", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", color=TITLE_C)

# Highlight youth vs elder contrast for SSA
ax2.annotate("", xy=(5, 5), xytext=(0, 38),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color=REGION_COLORS["Sub-Saharan Africa"],
                             lw=1.2, linestyle="dashed"))
ax2.text(2.4, 18, "−33 pp\n(SSA 15–24→65+)", ha="center", fontsize=8,
         color=REGION_COLORS["Sub-Saharan Africa"], style="italic")

# ── Panel 3: Urban-Rural grouped bars ─────────────────────────────────────
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
style_ax(ax3)

n = len(REGIONS)
x = np.arange(n)
w = 0.32
urban_vals = [urban_data[r][0] for r in REGIONS]
rural_vals = [urban_data[r][1] for r in REGIONS]
gaps       = [u - r for u, r in zip(urban_vals, rural_vals)]

b_u = ax3.bar(x - w/2, urban_vals, width=w, color=colors, zorder=3,
              edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5, label="Urban")
b_r = ax3.bar(x + w/2, rural_vals, width=w, color=colors, zorder=3,
              edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.42, label="Rural",
              hatch="///", linewidth=0.3)

for i, (u, r, g) in enumerate(zip(urban_vals, rural_vals, gaps)):
    ax3.text(i - w/2, u + 1.5, f"{u}%", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
             color=ANNOT_C, fontweight="bold")
    ax3.text(i + w/2, r + 1.5, f"{r}%", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
             color=ANNOT_C, fontweight="bold")
    ax3.text(i, max(u, r) + 9, f"Δ{g}", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8.5,
             color=REGION_COLORS[REGIONS[i]], fontweight="bold")

ax3.set_xticks(x)
ax3.set_xticklabels([REGION_SHORT[r] for r in REGIONS], fontsize=9.5, color=ANNOT_C)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 115)
ax3.set_ylabel("Internet Penetration (%)", fontsize=9, color=ANNOT_C)
ax3.set_title("Urban vs. Rural Split by Region", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", color=TITLE_C)

from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_handles = [
    Patch(facecolor="#888888", label="Urban (solid)"),
    Patch(facecolor="#888888", alpha=0.42, hatch="///", label="Rural (hatched)"),
]
ax3.legend(handles=legend_handles, fontsize=8.5, frameon=False,
           loc="upper right", labelcolor=ANNOT_C)

# ── Panel 4: Youth (15-24) vs Elder (65+) dot plot ───────────────────────
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
style_ax(ax4)
ax4.yaxis.grid(False)
ax4.xaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_C, linewidth=0.7, zorder=0)
ax4.set_axisbelow(True)

y_pos = np.arange(len(REGIONS))
for i, r in enumerate(REGIONS):
    youth = age_data[r][0]   # 15-24
    elder = age_data[r][-1]  # 65+
    color = REGION_COLORS[r]
    ax4.plot([elder, youth], [i, i], color=color, linewidth=3, zorder=2, alpha=0.7)
    ax4.scatter(youth, i, color=color, s=80, zorder=4, marker="o")
    ax4.scatter(elder, i, color=color, s=80, zorder=4, marker="D")
    ax4.text(youth + 1.5, i,  f"{youth}%", va="center", fontsize=9,
             color=color, fontweight="bold")
    ax4.text(elder - 1.5, i,  f"{elder}%", va="center", ha="right", fontsize=9,
             color=color, fontweight="bold")

ax4.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax4.set_yticklabels([REGION_SHORT[r] for r in REGIONS], fontsize=10, color=ANNOT_C)
ax4.set_xlim(0, 108)
ax4.set_xlabel("Internet Penetration (%)", fontsize=9, color=ANNOT_C)
ax4.set_title("Youth (15–24) vs. Elderly (65+)", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", color=TITLE_C)
ax4.spines["left"].set_visible(False)
ax4.tick_params(left=False)

youth_dot = plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker="o", color="w", markerfacecolor="#555",
                       markersize=7, label="Age 15–24")
elder_dot = plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker="D", color="w", markerfacecolor="#555",
                       markersize=7, label="Age 65+")
ax4.legend(handles=[youth_dot, elder_dot], fontsize=8.5, frameon=False,
           loc="lower right", labelcolor=ANNOT_C)

# ── Master legend ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=REGION_COLORS[r], label=r) for r in REGIONS]
fig.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc="upper center", ncol=4,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.963), fontsize=10.5, frameon=False,
           labelcolor=ANNOT_C)

# ── Main title ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.5, 0.983, "The Global Digital Divide: Internet Penetration Inequality Across Four Dimensions",
         ha="center", va="top", fontsize=17, fontweight="bold", color=TITLE_C)
fig.text(0.5, 0.965, "Internet penetration rates (%) by income, age, urban–rural setting, and region · 2023 estimates",
         ha="center", va="top", fontsize=10, color="#666666")

# ── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight",
            facecolor=BG, edgecolor="none")
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
